notes: Built-in image generation tool used for all slides. Visual character-by-character comparison against expected.json was performed after generation. s1, s3, and s4 matched all expected text on visual inspection. s2 was regenerated once to correct the Japanese wave-dash instruction; the final text visually matches, though the glyph shape is font-dependent. s5 received one targeted follow-up regeneration after transcription review found its four leading T4-T7 glyphs looked like U+2022 bullets followed by spaces. In the revised s5, each leading mark is rendered as a small centered, nearly square Japanese middle dot matching the internal middle dots in T7, with no added gap before the following text. All T1-T9 wording, characters, line wrapping, placement, colors, and highlights were visually checked against expected.json and the slide specification. No forbidden words, added text, logos, watermarks, signatures, arrows-with-text, flags, parentheses, or question marks were observed.
